notes: Teaching language transition: English in semesters 1-2, German from semester 3 (quoted). Tuition: the programme page states 1,500 EUR per semester for non-EU applicants; the university cost page repeats the same figure per semester for non-EU degree-seeking students (the 'per year' fee is not stated). Intakes: the '15 May latest for international applicants' is explicitly a RECOMMENDED timeline (for visa reasons), not a stated deadline, and no year is given, hence recurringDeadline; the general deadline '31 July' (no year) is not documented as applying to non-EU applicants, so it was left out. The pages do not mention uni-assist at all; the stated route is the university's own portal (campus.th-mannheim.de), so de-university-direct. German language skills are explicitly not mandatory for admission (A2 recommended).

evidence.quote: English language skills B2 required, please provide an official language certificate, e.g.: IELTS Academic: 6.5 TOEFL iBT (before 2026): 88

note.fr: Un certificat de fin d'études secondaires ou un relevé de notes universitaire très bon est attendu, avec un accent sur les notes en maths et en physique ; vérifiez si votre qualification donne un accès direct ou si un Studienkolleg/des études préalables sont exigés.
note.en: A very good school-leaving certificate or university transcript is expected, with a focus on Maths and Physics grades; check whether your qualification gives direct access or whether a Studienkolleg/additional study is required.

evidence.quote: applicants should have a very good school-leaving certificate or university transcript

They need to attend a certain number of semesters in a Bachelor course in engineering in their home country or alternatively they can complete a Studienkolleg in Germany prior to their application to Technische Hochschule Mannheim.
